difficulty_rationale: Four backend requirements each extending an already-released module family (DDL-03 three-phase form; OBP-01..03 outbox; ORD-01/02/04 ordering; VLD-01..03 validation). Each is a new feature with schema/migration + API + integration tests, no cross-module engine/scheduler/auth internals.
integration_surface_rationale: Each requirement extends one existing module family (src/platform, outbox, src/ordering, definition validation) with some caller updates; no engine/scheduler/auth middleware signature changes.
